assumptions.choice: Entry stop orders are submitted during next() after observing the day's Open and become eligible on the following daily bar; end-of-session close orders similarly execute on the next available daily bar.
assumptions.reason: With the fixed daily OHLC feed and no stated cheat-on-open/session callback configuration, Backtrader cannot submit and fill orders within the already-observed opening session or close a position at that same session's end.

assumptions.choice: PeakHigh/PeakLow and give-back tests use each bar's High/Low.
assumptions.reason: The specification explicitly names PeakHigh and PeakLow; High/Low are the closest observable daily-bar prices for those rules.

assumptions.choice: Equity is broker.getvalue() when the entry orders are submitted.
assumptions.reason: The specification says capital/equity but does not define a separate capital measure.
